ITEM 1 | Bright green florets with dark green tips and pale stems, clustered in a loose group on the left half of the plate, roughly 35 percent of plate area, florets about 2-3 cm across, firm and slightly glossy, with a few small pieces scattered among the eggs, some with light char-free moist surfaces | 110

ITEM 2 | Pale yellow to golden scrambled curds with soft, fluffy, crumbly texture and some slightly darker golden edges, spread across the right and center of the plate covering roughly 45 percent of plate area, piled about 1.5-2 cm high, dry-looking with no visible liquid pooling, pieces irregular and clumped | 150
